## Overview
Briefly describe what you want to do or decide.

## Problem Statement
Why is this task needed? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed Solution
How will you implement this or get it done?

## Checklist / Sub-tasks
- [ ] Initial step or research
- [ ] Core implementation
- [ ] Verification and testing

## Alternatives Considered
What other ways could you do this, and why did you skip them?
```

### How to Install It
1. Go to your repository's main page on GitHub.
2. Create the folder path `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/` and add the `rfc_todo.md` file, or use the [GitHub Repository Settings](https://github.com) interface under **Settings** > **Features** > **Issues** > **Set up templates**.
3. Commit the changes to your default branch.
